summary: Source-anchored research for Side bucket catalog. Run status: COMPLETED.

facts.text: Alibaba Cloud’s July 2025 engine-parameter release notes list exposure of timeseriesSideBucketCatalogMemoryUsageThreshold for its MongoDB 8.0 service; this is a managed-service availability date, not evidence that upstream MongoDB introduced the mechanism in July 2025. (low confidence)
The parameter defines when idle-bucket expiry begins; treating it as a guaranteed ceiling on total mongod memory is unsupported by these interfaces and the regression test. (medium confidence)

At MongoDB revision 35647d07bc4bc11966c90fe7100eb1db0b0ac1d9, timeseriesSideBucketCatalogMemoryUsageThreshold is a byte threshold above which idle buckets in the side bucket catalog are expired; Alibaba Cloud documents the same threshold semantics. (medium confidence)

At MongoDB commit 35647d07, timeseriesSideBucketCatalogMemoryUsageThreshold is expressed in bytes and defaults to 104857600 bytes (100 MiB); the ApsaraDB MongoDB 8.0 parameter table independently lists the same numeric default. (high confidence)
The pinned parameter definition allows startup and runtime configuration. MongoDB’s regression test at revision 46e8db22 exercises both configuration modes. (high confidence)

The side catalog has a separate idle-bucket-expiry memory threshold, timeseriesSideBucketCatalogMemoryUsageThreshold; the regression test isolates it by configuring 1 MiB for the side catalog and 100 MiB for the main catalog. (high confidence)

The regression test at revision 46e8db22 expects numBucketsArchivedDueToMemoryThreshold to increase after it induces side-catalog memory pressure; its comments allow subsequent closure if archival does not reclaim enough memory, and it checks that memory-triggered closures do not outnumber memory-triggered archivals. (low confidence)

The BucketCatalog header provides getSideBucketCatalogCollectionStats and documents that it assumes statistics for one collection; it also declares mergeExecutionStatsToBucketCatalog for merging collection execution statistics. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-24)
